attendance.note: Organiser-reported: MOON OF JAPAN's Facebook post of 29 May 2026 on the 38th SCN (24 May 2026) says '来場者数はなんと12,000人を記録', with 1,200 show car entries, 17 pinstripers and 140 swap meet booths.
